root_cause.finding: GftSignedMac is a FLAT module with ZERO instances of GftSmul or GftSadd. It re-implements the multiply inline, using the identical hidden-bit line prod = __mul_noop((512 + am), (512 + bm)) -- and OMITS the zero guards that GftSmul carries (if (a == 0) at line 258, if (b == 0) at line 262).
root_cause.consequence: mac(0,x,0,y) = 512 + 4x. The implicit leading one is added even when the operand is zero, so zero is not an annihilator in the MAC while it IS in smul -- which is exactly what the die reported for both.

validation_of_w976.method: re-ran the ZERO probe gated on the module's own ready
validation_of_w976.result: 16 violations in 16 points with ready high; result = 512 + 4*live
validation_of_w976.verdict: W976's 64/64 stands; it was not a sampling artefact
validation_of_w976.note: GftSmul/GftSignedMac assign ready = 1'b1, so the gate is vacuous here -- but it had to be checked before standing behind the claim
